data.title: 苍崎青子 · 洋馆晨曦的白被初醒慵懒
data.description: 久远寺洋馆主卧的厚重天鹅绒窗帘被晨风拂开一角，晨曦如金粉洒在凌乱的复古大床上。青子侧身躺在被单间，身上单薄的针织睡衣滑落一边，露出线条优美的小麦色锁骨与光洁香肩。长长的红发在白色枕席上蜿蜒如炽火，她睡眼微睁，唇角泛起毫不设防的初醒浅笑，向身旁之人打着懒洋洋的早安招呼。
data.action: lying on side amidst rumpled white bedsheets, off-shoulder knit sleep top, long red hair tangled on pillows, sleepy fond gaze, morning sunbeam highlighting collarbone
data.location: antique mansion bedroom with high ceilings and heavy velvet curtains
data.lighting: soft pristine morning sunbeam streaming across white bedsheets
data.mood: unguarded tender domesticity, rare vulnerable magical morning
data.promptProse: Waking up on rumpled white sheets in an antique mansion bedroom, Aoko Aozaki stretches on her side in an off-shoulder knit top. Her long auburn hair flows across pillows as she looks up with sleepy, affectionate eyes in the morning light.
data.animaCaption: Aoko waking up on white sheets in an off-shoulder knit top, smiling with sleepy affection.
